home.heroText: Thousands of books, one quiet room. Reserve online, pick up at the desk.
home.subjectsText: From first-year reading lists to the rare corners of the stacks — every subject, one quiet room.

steps.title: Reserve online
steps.text: Add up to {max} books to your borrow bag and reserve them in one go. We pull them from the shelves for you.

steps.title: Pick up at the desk
steps.text: When your books are ready, show your QR code within {hours} hours. A librarian checks them out to you.

steps.title: Return in {days} days
steps.text: Renew once online if nobody is waiting. Late returns cost {fine} a day — we'll remind you before then.
